description.value: Taste of Saigon Cafe is a Vietnamese restaurant on Squamish's main commercial strip, Cleveland Avenue, sitting along the Sea to Sky cycling corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. It offers indoor seating in a smoke-free environment, making it a sheltered rest stop for cyclists passing through town. Vietnamese cuisine — pho, banh mi, and similar dishes — tends to be hearty and well-suited to the appetite of a touring cyclist.
